articles.author: Anthony Ha
articles.title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce - TechCrunch
articles.description: The filing also says that the “vast majority” of Character.AI employees who were offered jobs at Disney accepted them. However, this is a stalking horse bid, so another company could come forward with a higher offer.
articles.content:
After chatbot startup Character.AI filed for bankruptcy earlier this week, many of its employees will have the opportunity to take jobs at Disney.
